spectral_conditions.energy_definition: Per-token mean over four directions of log1p(pooled native Gabor power/1e-4), then mass-weighted regional mean.
spectral_conditions.covariance_definition: Dot product of standardized, region-pooled, unit-normalized 32-D joint descriptors at each wavelength.
spectral_conditions.display: Both VV and VH, body region; query and all four displayed actual references.

matrix_axes: K/T: class, reference_rank, polarization, query_token, reference_token
T_definition: Sinkhorn(exp(pad(K/0.1))) with unmatched row/column; real-real block after positive-mass mask; not row-normalized.
local_definition: For each class/polarization/region: mean over 2 refs of [sum(T*K), sum(T)].
scope: Only two preselected cases; no training, fitting, weights edits, or population estimate.
